rule.statement: The Defendants are entitled to the payment of liquidated damages in terms of P1 for the period between 1st June 2004 – 19th January 2006.
rule.supporting_quote: I am therefore of the view that the Defendants are entitled to the payment of liquidated damages in terms of P1 for the period between 1st June 2004 – 19th January 2006 and that the Plaintiff is liable to pay liquidated damages at the rate of Rs. 650 per day for the said period.
